text: How many 4-digit even numbers have all 4 digits distinct?
solution: Split on the units digit. If it is 0: 1 x 9 x 8 x 7 = 504. If it is 2, 4, 6 or 8: 4 choices for the units digit, then 8 for the leading digit (not 0, not the units digit), then 8, then 7, giving 4 x 8 x 8 x 7 = 1792. Total 504 + 1792 = 2296. The most restricted position here is the units digit, not the leading digit.
